verdict.rationale: Kushki's own marketing lists "Smartlink — Crea y personaliza links de pago", a first-party product for creating and customizing payment links, so the core capability exists. The evidence is only a one-line product heading, with nothing showing it is built from a dashboard without code or that a merchant can start selling immediately. Missing for 10: dashboard-based no-code creation flow, sharing/distribution details, onboarding speed to go live, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
